gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of GBM according to WHO 2016 classification criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of the current study is to test if the earlier introduction of Optune®, at the time of radiation therapy (which is given together with temozolomide), improves clinical outcomes compared to the standard of care.
All patients are to receive standard RT and TMZ treatment followed by maintenance TMZ chemotherapy and Optune® according to the current standard of care regimen.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Pivotal, Randomized, Open-label Study of Optune® (Tumor Treating Fields) Concomitant With RT & TMZ for the Treatment of Newly Diagnosed GBM

role_evidence.quote: All patients are to receive standard RT and TMZ treatment followed by maintenance TMZ chemotherapy and Optune® according to the current standard of care regimen.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

biomarkers.biomarker_other: unspecified tumour sample laboratory test used for randomisation

source_quote.quote: After surgery or biopsy, subjects that would like to participate will be required to submit samples of their tumor to a lab for testing. The results of this test will be used for randomization into the trial.

coder_notes: Device trial (TTFields timing); phase NA. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it (standard RT/TMZ); listed as soc_backbone.
